info.name: Ignition Gateway REST access-control audit API

params.name: actorFilter
params.description: A filter string used to restrict the results by actor.

params.name: actionFilter
params.description: A filter string used to restrict the results by action.

params.name: targetFilter
params.description: A filter string used to restrict the results by target.

params.name: valueFilter
params.description: A filter string used to restrict the results by value.

params.name: systemFilter
params.description: A filter string used to restrict the results by system.

params.name: contextFilter
params.description: An ApplicationScope character set for scopes. 'C' for Client, 'D' for Designer, 'G' for Gateway, 'A' for All.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Include results starting from this timestamp (Epoch millis).

params.name: endTime
params.description: Include results up to this timestamp (Epoch millis).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before returning results.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The name of a field to sort by. Use `asc(fieldName)` or `desc(fieldName)`
to specify the sort direction as ascending or descending, respectively.

params.name: search
params.description: A search string to filter items by. Terms separated by whitespace.

params.name: key_0
params.description: Filter items by field name, using format like `fieldName[op]=value` where `op` is one of: `eq` (equals), `ne` (not equals), `cn` (contains), `sw` (starts with), `ew` (ends with), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), `rgx` (regular expression).
